scope: External database access on the owner's real server (Ubuntu 26.04, Sbarbase 0.6.1 to 0.6.3 installed through the signed release channel), environment fanio (e_7fcba0bea7b22726ce369832). Run by an agent on 2026-10-24. Not a security certification and not a load test.

versions.note: each install restarts every application on the server for about two minutes (the documented restart); the in-place handover for code only releases is still a design

path: Cloudflare Hyperdrive -> Workers VPC service (tcp 127.0.0.1:6545, certificate verification disabled) -> Cloudflare Tunnel connector (cloudflared 2026.10.3, systemd unit, DynamicUser) -> Sbarbase external listener (TLS only) -> PostgreSQL SCRAM

before_opt_in.hyperdrive_create_with_wrong_password_an: Failed to connect to the provided database: External database access is not enabled for this environment (SQLSTATE 28000) [code: 2015]
before_opt_in.meaning: Hyperdrive reached the listener through the tunnel, finished TLS (sslmode require) and sent its startup message; the listener refused the environment before PostgreSQL

negative_checks_from_the_server_to_127.0.wrong_password_own_environment: password authentication failed (PostgreSQL's own SCRAM answer)
negative_checks_from_the_server_to_127.0.login_of_an_environment_that_did_not_opt: refused: External database access is not enabled for this environment
negative_checks_from_the_server_to_127.0.superuser_login: refused: Only an environment developer login (e_…_developer) can connect here
negative_checks_from_the_server_to_127.0.service_login: refused: Only an environment developer login (e_…_developer) can connect here
negative_checks_from_the_server_to_127.0.own_login_other_database: refused: The developer login connects to its own database
negative_checks_from_the_server_to_127.0.twelve_wrong_passwords: attempts 1 to 8 answered by PostgreSQL, the 9th and later refused: Too many failed logins; the journal records 'closed for 60 s after 10 failed logins' (two earlier probes counted)

after_opt_in.password_replaced_with: sbarbase database-password sbarah/fanio/production --output FILE (v0.6.3); the connection string never reached a screen or a log
after_opt_in.hyperdrive_create: fanio-db created, caching disabled, 8 origin connections; its creation tests a real login

worker_transaction.worker: temporary, behind a random header, deleted afterwards

not_covered: load or many concurrent Hyperdrive sessions
certificate renewal on the real server (unit tested by comparing what a client trusting each authority sees)
a client other than Hyperdrive on a public address
